summary_markdown: The discussion centered on a `ValueError` encountered during the recalculation process, specifically 'More than one traffic trend adjustment coefficient for the same hour'. [p2] noted difficulty identifying and cleaning duplicate data records. [p1] suggested that instead of failing completely, the system should ideally skip processing only the problematic company while continuing calculations for others. [p1] subsequently fixed the issue by removing the duplicated coefficients and restarted the recalculation process.
decisions: The recalculation error was resolved by removing duplicate traffic trend adjustment coefficients.
